summary: Main's warm jobs drop the linked executables (test binaries, examples, binaries) from a Cargo target before saving it as an Actions cache (scripts/ci-cargo-cache-trim), after the exact-source build snapshot has packed the whole target. The repository's caches share a 10 GB limit and were at 10.15 GB, so GitHub evicted one every hour or two. In linux-tests' target the executables are 71% of 16.2 GB.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: What every check builds and runs is unchanged. A build that restores a trimmed cache relinks the executables it needs, from the cached libraries.

manual.detail: After the next main run that saves a cargo cache, the repository's cache list shows the smaller entries.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; the next cache saves are whole targets again.
